title: Preserve existing cards and codes during UI work
trigger: UI change in the loyalty-card wallet
observed_problem: User explicitly excluded QR/barcode/scanner/storage from visual tasks
approach_that_failed: Scope creep into protected data/code flows
effective_approach: Limit diff and verify existing cards/data after UI change
exceptions: Change protected flows only in a separately authorized task
prevention_rule: Preserve card data and QR/barcode/scanner/storage unless explicitly authorized

title: Static checks do not verify deployment or phone behavior
observed_problem: Static checks coexisted with old Pages UI and unverified device flows
approach_that_failed: Treating source checks as proof of live deployment
effective_approach: Verify source commit, publication source, live URL, phone runtime and key interactions
exceptions: A static check can only establish the property it tests
prevention_rule: Report source, deployment, runtime and regression statuses separately

title: Reproduce scanner, gallery and crop regressions independently
trigger: Several UI paths reported broken after changes
observed_problem: Scanner hang, gallery import failure and crop reposition regression were reported
approach_that_failed: Assigning one cause to several unverified symptoms
effective_approach: Reproduce each flow, inspect handler/state/render path, then run adjacent regressions
exceptions: Do not infer cause from commit names alone
prevention_rule: Track each user-visible path with its own reproduction and acceptance evidence

title: A requested brand catalog is not proof of integrated templates
observed_problem: A branch and commit were mentioned but complete integration was not verified
approach_that_failed: Claiming completion from branch/commit mention alone
effective_approach: Compare actual catalog to accepted brand list and test adding a template while preserving existing cards
exceptions: Do not assume every listed brand exists in the final build
prevention_rule: Verify catalog contents and real add-template behavior against the full list
